title: Post-Traumatic Growth
subtitle: How post-traumatic growth supports long-term resilience, health, and sustainable behavior.
related_modules: STR-037: Resilience Training and Coping Strategies
STR-099: Psychological Trauma and PTSD Fundamentals
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the existence of post-traumatic growth as a positive outcome following trauma for many individuals. Moderate evidence exists on physiological correlates and intervention efficacy. Some emerging and inconsistent findings relate to neurobiological mechanisms and cultural variability. Overall, the evidence base is growing but requires cautious interpretation respecting individual differences.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
